name: 01501 · Auburn, MA
findings: ZIP 01501 (Auburn) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01501 (Auburn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01501 (Auburn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
